## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature being addressed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation/String update(s) which has/have no significant code change(s)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have run local linter checks (`composer fix`, `composer cs`, etc.) and all checks pass.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or errors.
- [ ] I have used `__()` (on PHP and Twig files) or `tjs()` (on JS files), to make strings translateable.
- [ ] I created/updated the relevant documentation pages myself or informed the documentation team for my changes.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works (if applicable).
- [ ] New and existing unit/integration/feature tests pass locally with my changes.

## Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO) & Licensing

- [ ] **I agree to the [Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO)](CONTRIBUTING.md).** I have signed off on all my commits using `git commit -s` or `--signoff`.
- [ ] **I agree that my contribution is licensed under the [GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0)](LICENSE).**
